author: China Insights
description:
Once one of China’s most recognisable actresses, Zhao Wei built a reputation that extended far beyond film — becoming a prominent investor and appearing on major wealth rankings. But in recent years, her public presence changed dramatically. Projects disappeared, appearances stopped, and financial disputes began to surface.

In this episode, we trace the full arc of her story — from early fame to her entry into high-profile investments, and the developments that followed. By examining publicly reported transactions, regulatory actions, and broader financial networks, we explore how rapid success, leverage, and shifting policy environments can intersect in complex ways.

Rather than focusing on speculation, this video looks at the timeline, the structures involved, and the wider context behind one of the most discussed cases in China’s entertainment and business landscape.

title: China’s Richest Actress — Then Everything Disappeared
